description: Send a KOL campaign brief to BCA Studio. Required: contact_email, project_name, campaign_type (thread, video, space, podcast or hybrid) and budget_usd (500 to 2,000,000 USD). Free to submit; needs an API key (the free tier is enough). Each brief alerts BCA Studio, who reply to contact_email by hand with a recommended KOL slate and quote (nothing is emailed automatically). Returns request_id, status and next_step.

budget_usd.description: Required. Budget in whole US dollars, 500 to 2,000,000.

campaign_type.description: Required. Campaign format: thread, video, space, podcast or hybrid.

contact_email.description: Required. Where BCA Studio sends the recommended KOL slate and quote.

notes.description: Optional brief: goals, audience, timing (up to 4,000 characters).

project_name.description: Required. Project or brand name (2 to 200 characters).

project_slug.description: Optional BCA entity slug for the project (e.g. 'ethereum').

target_chains.description: Optional chains the campaign targets, up to 12 (e.g. ['solana', 'base']).

name: book_kol_campaign
